title: Thornton Heath Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency health facilities, brook flood risks, and essential supply points for Thornton Heath.
content: For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 immediately. 1. Nearest Hospitals with 24-Hour A&E: - Croydon University Hospital (530 London Road, Thornton Heath, CR7 7YE). Directions from Thornton Heath Station: ~15 min walk south along Brigstock Road and London Road (0.7 miles), or take bus 198, 250, or 450 south directly to the hospital gates. - St George's Hospital (Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT) — Designated Major Trauma Centre. Directions from Norbury Station: ~3.5 miles north-west; take bus 50 or 255 towards Tooting Broadway, or take Southern rail to Balham for the Northern line to Tooting Broadway. 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: - Croydon Urgent Treatment Centre (located at Croydon University Hospital, 530 London Road, CR7 7YE). Open 24 hours daily for urgent minor illnesses, stitched wounds, burns, and simple fractures. Located 0.7 miles south of Thornton Heath Clock Tower. 3. Local Hazard Notes: The Norbury Brook (part of the River Graveney catchment) flows through Thornton Heath and Norbury. Low-lying zones along Brigstock Road underpasses, London Road, and Norbury Park are susceptible to rapid surface and fluvial waterlogging during high-intensity storms. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and high-street grocery stores along Brigstock Road, High Street, and London Road supply clean bottled water, over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, and wound dressings. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
